ModelsSettings.description: The model configuration of `--model-config` and of the `models` kind of `/$/server/settings/models`: providers, role lists and routing. The web UI builds its form from this schema.

providers.description: Providers by name. Names can contain only letters, digits and the characters _ - .
providers.title: Providers

roles.description: The provider and model pairs each step calls, in order. Each role list is one field.

community.description: Writes GraphRAG community reports. Uses the summarize list when unset. An empty list turns it off.
community.title: community

draft.description: Drafts the first query for a question. The first entry is used, and the server moves to the next only on signals it verifies. Off when unset.
draft.title: draft

explain.description: Writes the text of a query explanation. Off when unset.
explain.title: explain

extract.description: Extracts facts from document chunks and drafts CSV mappings. Off when unset.
extract.title: extract

optimize.description: Proposes query rewrites. Off when unset.
optimize.title: optimize

repair.description: Drafts a new query after a diagnosis. Uses the draft list when unset. An empty list turns it off.
repair.title: repair

summarize.description: Writes the answer from the result rows. Off when unset.
summarize.title: summarize

roles.title: Roles

routing.description: When a question starts at the second entry of a role list instead of the first.

complexityThreshold.description: Queries whose complexity score reaches this value start repair, or the next draft, at the second entry of the list. A dataset's assistant settings can override it.
complexityThreshold.title: Complexity threshold

exampleScore.description: The score from 0 to 1 the best stored example needs before its complexity counts.
exampleScore.title: Example score

routing.title: Routing
